FN-ZQGPAKK-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 332
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/17/2025
House Bill 332 as introduced would codify existing rule of the State Department of Education
to require public school students, beginning with graduates of the 2031-2032 school year, to
earn at least one credit in a department approved computer science course. This bill could
increase the administrative obligations of the department to ensure that computer science
courses meet certain instructional criteria.
